name: My Magical Girlfriends
source: You have the strange power to see the auras of others. One day, on your way to university, you come across a girl who exudes a mysterious rainbow-colored aura. You decide to follow her, only to discover that she is actually a… magical girl?! The girl introduces herself as Elise, and now that you’ve uncovered her secret, you won’t be able to go for free. You wind up helping her with her homework for her magic school, together with her two familiars. But stepping into a world of magic isn’t all fun in games, as you soon find yourself caught up in a battle between Elise and her not-so-friendly rival...
translation: 你拥有一种奇妙的能力，能看见他人身上的灵光。一天，在去大学的路上，你遇到了一位周身散发着神秘虹色灵光的少女。你决定跟上去，结果发现她竟然是个…魔法少女？！少女自称伊莉丝，既然你已经发现了她的秘密，自然不能就这么走人。于是，你不得不和她的两名使魔一起，帮她完成魔法学校的作业。然而，魔法世界并不总是充满欢乐，你很快就被卷入了伊莉丝与她那位不太友善的宿敌之间的争斗…
